## Overview
A safety net woven into the Great Sacrifice: a protective effect across all planes of existence, lasting 100 years from the moment of B's shattering. While it held, neither A, nor C, nor any god could directly interfere with the planes or the development of the mortal races.

## Mechanism
The shield impedes direct influence from an Original arcane source. The gods carry an Original power source (they are sub-parts of A and C), so the shield binds them by their nature.

## The Hundred Years
After the 100 years the protection diminished - though it never vanished entirely. The gods can now interact with and interfere in the planes, though only to a limited degree. Working through the weakened protection, the gods eventually opened the planar rifts and executed their invasion plan against the mortal races.

## [GM] The Divine Magic Loophole
Divine magic is NOT limited by the protection. The true source of a paladin's or cleric's magic is the mortal caster themselves; the god merely weaves their arcane signature into the magic the mortal manifests - then lies, claiming the powers are god-given.
